caseNameFull: Attwood v. Smith Attwood v. Palm Beach Post

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. Fla.; and

Dist. Ct. App. Fla., 4th Dist. Motions of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied. See this Court’s Rule 39.8. Petitioner is allowed until November 27, 1995, within which to pay the docketing fees required by Rule 38(a) and to submit petitions in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
